data.name: Behind every consistently crafted cup is a commitment to sourcing the right ingredients. From carefully selected tea leaves to the production of our signature bubbles, every ingredient is managed under consistent quality standards to ensure trust begins at the source. With the establishment of our own pearl production facility, we have strengthened our ability to manage quality, specifications, and supply stability—ensuring every bubble served meets KOI’s standards.

Việc xây dựng nhà máy sản xuất trân châu riêng giúp chúng tôi chủ động hơn về chất lượng, quy cách và nguồn cung, bảo đảm mỗi hạt trân châu đều đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn KOI.

data.name: Beyond professional development, we care deeply about the well-being and connection of our people. data.name: Precision goes beyond the brewing process—it represents our commitment to every customer. This ensures every customer can enjoy the same trusted KOI experience, with every cup reflecting our dedication to quality and care.
